scope: One local standard-library consumption of the two existing aggregate JSON files, supervised by an external 60-second timeout; no execution was performed during this review.
findings: The existing ledger reports acquired task means but does not subtract the corresponding S0 score gap; this bounded contrast answers that specific descriptive question.
The consumer checks all 19 task keys, matching QA counts and total 21454, finite score ranges, and agreement of acquired/final task means with the existing acquisition evidence.
Task-equal AP19-style contrasts and copied domain aggregates are reported separately. Both trajectories retain all initial, acquired and final values.
Exclusive output creation prevents silently overwriting an earlier attempt. Input, source and question hashes are checked before consumption.
limitations: R>0 rejects only the same-point constant-offset account of the observed acquisition score gap; it is not an adjusted causal effect and does not exclude effects of initial parameterization on later optimization.
Acquired minus S0 combines preceding-task transfer and current-stage effects; it is not current-stage-only learning and does not identify knowledge content.
A positive arithmetic contrast does not establish significance, stability, equivalence, projection necessity, removable weights, or a successful compact representation.
The 60-second deadline must be enforced by the external supervisor; the consumer does not implement its own hard timeout.
No result permits TEST-based recipe selection, another model attempt, or reopening any closed research point.
review_performed: Static source and question review, plus inspection of existing aggregate schema and small-file SHA256 bindings only; the consumer was not imported or executed.
